headline: Saudi Arabia Identifies $1 Trillion in Infrastructure Investment Opportunities
summary: Saudi Arabia has identified infrastructure investment opportunities worth approximately $1 trillion over the next eight to 10 years, according to the Minister of Economy and Planning.
why: Large-scale infrastructure pipelines signal long-term capital expenditure plans designed to diversify national economies away from oil.

impacts.name: Saudi Arabia
impacts.why: Unveiling major infrastructure pipelines attracts international contractors and project financing.
